name: phase3-usage-signals
question: Do changes in snap share, carry share and target share predict opportunity and PPR production over a player's team's next 2-4 games, beyond recent fantasy production?
status: Pre-registered 2026-11-12 before any outcome was computed. Exploratory: correlational, no causal claim.
decisions: every regular-season week w from 4 to (last regular-season week - 4) in each fit and holdout season; instant = 12 h after the last kickoff of week w (src/validation/calendar.ts)
population: main stats position in the group; at least 3 games played in the current season, final by the instant

targets.points: PPR points (site scoring) over the player's current team's next H scheduled regular-season games, divided by H; a missed game counts as 0
targets.opportunities: carries + targets over the same games, divided by H; a missed game counts as 0

production.P_L4: PPR points over the team's last 4 games, missed games as 0, divided by 4
production.P_STD: season-to-date PPR points per team game, missed games as 0
production.F_RATE: challenger F's input rate: recency-weighted points per scheduled team game over the harness history window (baseline B's rate)

usage.snap: offensive snap share (provider-reported, joined by PFR id)
usage.volume: carries + targets per team game over the last 4 team games (comparison: raw volume, not a share)
usage.level: share over the player's last 4 games played
usage.change: share over his last 2 games played minus share over up to 4 games played before those

models: OLS per position x target x horizon, fitted on fit-period rows only. M0 = production only. Then M0 + each usage feature alone (level, change, level+change), then M0 + all shares, then M0 + all shares + volume.
metrics: holdout MAE, RMSE, out-of-sample R2; paired MAE difference vs M0 with a 95% player-cluster bootstrap interval (1,000 resamples, seed 20261112); signed M0 residual in the top and bottom decile of each change feature (decile cut points from fit-period rows)
sample: rows missing snap share are excluded from every model at that position, so all models are scored on identical rows; the exclusion count is reported
decisionRule: Recommend adding a usage feature to F only if, at H = 3 on the points target, adding it to M0 lowers holdout MAE with a bootstrap interval entirely below zero at every position it applies to. If several qualify, recommend the one with the largest relative reduction. Otherwise recommend none.
